description:
The Aviator is our first true motorcycle. Built from the ground up on a custom frame, it rides like the cafe racer you always wanted and draws the eyes of the crowd everywhere you park it.

This is the ultimate ride for the person who wants to actually enjoy their daily commute, and who wants something to explore their city with on the weekend. Your ride to work becomes the best fifteen minutes of your day, a trip to the coffee shop turns into a reason to take the long way home, and you do it all without burning a drop of gasoline.

The Light Motorcycle runs to 45 mph. It is registered, plated and insured like any other motorcycle, it needs a motorcycle license, and it is not ridden in bike lanes. Want something without the paperwork? The Aviator Moped is limited to 20 mph and qualifies as a Class 2 e-bike in many states.

components.description: Front and back hydraulic disc brakes
Removable 4.3 kWh (60 Ah) lithium battery with built-in charge port
Tank glovebox with a double-locked battery door
120 V fast charger, 3 hours to 80% charge
Turn signals, loud horn, LED headlight and LED display
Steering lock, anti-theft motion alarm and remote start/stop
